import Mathlib

theorem putnam_2020_a2
  (k : ℕ) :
  (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k, 2 ^ (k - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) j) = 4 ^ k := by
  -- Base case: k = 0
  -- When k = 0, the sum has only one term: 2^(0-0) * choose(0,0) = 1 * 1 = 1 = 4^0
  -- Inductive step: assume true for k, prove for k+1
  -- Use the identity choose(n+1,r) = choose(n,r) + choose(n,r-1) to relate consecutive cases
  -- Carefully split the sum and reindex to apply the inductive hypothesis
  have h : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j = 4 ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top]
      · simp [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, pow_add, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
        -- Split the sum into j=n+1 term and j≤n terms
        -- Apply Pascal's identity and reorganize
        have h₁ : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + 1 + j) j = 
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * (Nat.choose (n + j) j + Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ]
          <;> simp_all [Finset.mem_Icc]
          <;> omega
        rw [h₁]
        -- Split into two sums and reindex
        have h₂ : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j = 
          2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) j := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          rw [show 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) = 2 * 2 ^ (n - j) by
            rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : j ≤ n)]
            ring_nf
            <;> simp [pow_succ]]
          ring
        have h₃ : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) = 
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          rw [show 2 ^ (n + 1 - j) = 2 * 2 ^ (n - j) by
            rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : j ≤ n)]
            ring_nf
            <;> simp [pow_succ]]
          ring
        rw [h₂, h₃]
        -- Reindex the second sum
        have h₄ : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 n, 2 ^ (n - j) * Nat.choose (n + j) (j - 1) = 
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 (n - 1), 2 ^ (n - 1 - j) * Nat.choose (n - 1 + j + 1) j := by
          apply Finset.sum_bij' (fun j _ => j - 1) (fun j _ => j + 1)
          <;> simp_all [Finset.mem_Icc]
          <;> omega
        rw [h₄]
        -- Combine and use inductive hypothesis
        simp [ih, pow_add, mul_assoc]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        <;> omega
      · omega
  exact h k
```
